text:
Three statements about solid Z are listed.
●
It reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to produce hydrogen.
●
It reacts very slowly with cold water and quickly with steam.
●
It is a good thermal conductor.
What is solid Z?
A
gold
B
magnesium
C
potassium
D
silver
subject: Chemistry
